svg.title: Concurrent insertions; per-actor Undo
svg.desc: A bounded example, not a universal conflict or ordering rule. 1 · Shared empty paragraph: A and B begin with the same schema and document state. Each replica has a distinct actor ID and its own History. 2 · Edit before receiving the other change: A inserts A; B independently inserts B. Each edit refers to observed token identities, not a global text offset. 3 · Exchange operations → converge: Both replicas contain both letters in the same token-defined order. No whole-document winner; letter order is not illustrated here. 4 · A undoes its insertion → synchronize Undo: A’s insertion is removed; B’s letter remains on both replicas. Undo is not restoring an old snapshot of everybody’s document.
